        by contradiction /* from formulas */

lemma nothing_served_under_a_credential_this_node_superseded:

  "∀ N C k #i #j.
    ((EvidenceHeld( N, C, k ) @ #i) ∧ (ServedUnder( N, C, k ) @ #j)) ⇒
    (#j < #i)"

  (EvidenceHeld( N, C, k ) @ #i) ∧ (ServedUnder( N, C, k ) @ #j)
 ∧

lemma nothing_delivered_after_supersession:
  all-traces
  "∀ N C k m #i #j.
    ((EvidenceHeld( N, C, k ) @ #i) ∧ (Delivered( N, C, k, m ) @ #j)) ⇒
    (#j < #i)"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ N C k m #i #j.
  (EvidenceHeld( N, C, k ) @ #i) ∧ (Delivered( N, C, k, m ) @ #j)
 ∧
  ¬(#j < #i)"
*/
simplify
solve( Binding( $N, $C, k ) ▶₀ #i )
  case Attach_Primary
  solve( Queued( $N, $C, k, m ) ▶₂ #j )
    case Enqueue
    solve( ServingAs( $N, $C, ~k, role, s ) @ #i.1 )
      case Attach_Primary
      solve( Session( $N, $C, ~k, 'primary', ~s ) ▶₀ #j )
        case Attach_Primary
        solve( Binding( $N, $C, ~k ) ▶₁ #j )
          case Attach_Primary
          solve( (#vr = #i.1)  ∥ (#vr = #vr.3)  ∥ (#i.1 = #vr.3) )
            case case_1
            solve( Binding( $N, $C, ~k ) ▶₀ #vr )
              case Attach_Primary
              by solve( (#vr = #vr.3)  ∥ (#vr.3 = #vr.4) )
            next
              case Deliver
              solve( ServingAs( $N, $C, ~k, role, s.2 ) @ #i.1 )

                solve( (#vr = #vr.3)  ∥ (#i.1 = #vr.3) )
                  case case_2

lemma no_attach_after_supersession:
  all-traces
  "∀ N C k s #i #j.
    ((EvidenceHeld( N, C, k ) @ #i) ∧ (Opened( N, C, k, s ) @ #j)) ⇒
    (#j < #i)"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ N C k s #i #j.
  (EvidenceHeld( N, C, k ) @ #i) ∧ (Opened( N, C, k, s ) @ #j)
 ∧
  ¬(#j < #i)"
*/
simplify
solve( (#j = #i)  ∥ (#i < #j) )
  case case_1
  solve( Binding( $N, $C, k ) ▶₀ #i )
    case Attach_Primary
    by solve( Opened( $N, $C, k, s.1 ) @ #i )
  next
    case Attach_Sibling
    by solve( Opened( $N, $C, k, s.1 ) @ #i )
  next
    case Deliver
    by solve( Opened( $N, $C, ~k, s.1 ) @ #i )
  next
    case Node_Records_Binding
    by solve( Opened( $N, $C, ~k, s ) @ #i )
  next
    case Trust_Bearing_Operation
    by solve( Opened( $N, $C, k, s.1 ) @ #i )
  qed
next
  case case_2

lemma a_queue_does_not_follow_the_successor_credential:
  all-traces
  "∀ N C k1 k2 m #e #s #d.
    ((((Enqueued( N, C, k1, m ) @ #e) ∧ (EvidenceHeld( N, C, k1 ) @ #s)) ∧
      (Delivered( N, C, k2, m ) @ #d)) ∧
     (#s < #d)) ⇒
    (⊥)"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ N C k1 k2 m #e #s #d.
  (Enqueued( N, C, k1, m ) @ #e) ∧
  (EvidenceHeld( N, C, k1 ) @ #s) ∧
  (Delivered( N, C, k2, m ) @ #d)
 ∧
  #s < #d"
*/
simplify
solve( !Cred( $C, k1 ) ▶₁ #e )
  case Client_Credential
  solve( Binding( $N, $C, ~k ) ▶₀ #s.1 )
    case Attach_Primary
    solve( Queued( $N, $C, k2, ~m ) ▶₂ #d )
      case Enqueue
      solve( ServingAs( $N, $C, ~k, role, s ) @ #i )
        case Attach_Primary
        solve( Session( $N, $C, ~k, 'primary', ~s ) ▶₀ #d )
          case Attach_Primary
          solve( Binding( $N, $C, ~k ) ▶₁ #d )
            case Attach_Primary
            solve( (#i = #vr.1)  ∥ (#i = #vr.2)  ∥ (#vr.1 = #vr.2) )
              case case_1
              solve( Binding( $N, $C, ~k ) ▶₀ #i )
                case Attach_Primary
                by solve( (#i = #vr.1)  ∥ (#vr.1 = #vr.2) )
              next
                case Deliver
                solve( ServingAs( $N, $C, ~k, role, s.3 ) @ #i.1 )
                  case Attach_Primary
                  solve( (#i = #vr.1)  ∥ (#i.1 = #vr.1) )
                    case case_2
                    solve( Binding( $N, $C, ~k ) ▶₀ #i.1 )
                      case Attach_Primary
                      by contradiction /* from formulas */
                    next
                      case Attach_Sibling
                      by contradiction /* from formulas */
                    next
                      case Deliver
                      by contradiction /* from formulas */
                    next
                      case Node_Records_Binding
                      solve( Session( $N, $C, ~k, 'primary', ~s.1 ) ▶₀ #vr.1 )
                        case Attach_Primary
                        solve( Binding( $N, $C, ~k ) ▶₁ #vr.1 )
                          case Attach_Sibling
                          by contradiction /* from formulas */
                        next
                          case Deliver
                          by contradiction /* from formulas */
                        next
                          case Trust_Bearing_Operation
                          by contradiction /* from formulas */
                        qed
                      next
                        case Deliver
                        by contradiction /* from formulas */
                      next
                        case Trust_Bearing_Operation
                        by contradiction /* from formulas */
                      qed
                    next
                      case Trust_Bearing_Operation
                      by contradiction /* from formulas */
                    qed
                  qed
                qed
              next
                case Node_Records_Binding
                solve( Binding( $N, $C, ~k ) ▶₀ #vr.1 )
                  case Attach_Primary
                  by solve( (#i = #vr.1)  ∥ (#i = #vr.3) )
                next
                  case Deliver
                  solve( ServingAs( $N, $C, ~k, role, s.3 ) @ #i.1 )
                    case Attach_Primary
                    solve( (#i = #i.1)  ∥ (#i = #vr.1) )
                      case case_1
